info.description: Bordered card that promotes another Interledger property from inside a blog post. Every field is optional, but fill in at least three of them, and at least one of the headline or the body.

helperText.description: Short label above the card. Example: Know more.

logo.description: Logo of the property you promote. Drawn at 44 x 44. Leave the alternative text empty when the label beside it says the same thing.

logoLabel.description: Name shown beside the logo. Example: Web Monetization.

socialLinks.description: Social profiles of the property you promote. Each one renders as a square icon button.

cta.description: One call-to-action button. The card allows a maximum of one.
